none: PAS CAM-4C2955: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy Nummus of Constantine I
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ GLORIA EXERCITVS ; D/ CONSTANTINVS MAX AVG

A copper-alloy nummus of Constantine I. Mint is Rome, AD330, (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads GLORIA EXERCITVS. Reverse shows two soldiers, two standards. See RIC VII, p.336, no.327. Obverse shows rosette-diademed, draped bust right. Obverse legend reads CONSTANTINVS MAX AVG. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //RFP. Die axis is 12 o'clock, weight is 2.15g, diameter is 18.57mm
